name: DVD-Player
author: joedaniels198512-gif
description: DVD-Player is a hybrid DVD-Video core for MiSTer and SuperStation One, combining an FPGA companion core with ARM-side DVD playback and navigation software. It supports physical DVDs and DVD-Video ISOs, authored menus, PAL and NTSC, subtitles, audio-track switching, and HDMI or CRT output.
